findings: The new alternative requires exactly one authored structure with the exact canonical source collection ID, exactly one corresponding visible runtime structure, and at least one actual source-collection task below it. An arbitrary label, generated ID spelling or unrelated task cannot establish the relation.

Every source-folder task remains independently checked for actual target visibility using exactly the pre-existing jurisdiction and unavailable-curricular-prerequisite filters. The change does not remove those obligations. Global endpoint presence remains the original rule; it is not newly required to nest every endpoint in one display group.

Missing canonical source collections now fail explicitly. Duplicate/absent source bindings and empty/unrelated collections fail. No title heuristic, source prerequisite fabrication or missing-reference fallback was added.
scope: Read-only review plus candidate-clone native preview tests; no source/view/canonical edits, no package/runtime/overall M7 approval.
